Method of Attack: Initial access via Qbot/QakBot banking trojan
Distribution of ransomware strains ProLock, Egregor, DoppelPaymer
Spread through emails from Emotet botnet and TA551 malware distribution service
Lateral movement using Cobalt Strike, Adfind, BloodHound, BITSadmin
Double-extortion model stealing data via Rclone before encrypting machines
Impacted Systems: Networks of at least eight French companies
Pharmaceutical companies Fareva and Pierre Fabre
Attack Vector: Malware distribution services TA551 (Shathak, UNC2420, Gold Cabin)
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses related to Conti ransomware found by Valery Marchive of LegMagIT
